installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Windrose Dedicated Server - Installation Script
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Install container: ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian

set -e

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
echo "Downloading SteamCMD..."
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd (Windows dedicated server, anonymous login)
echo "Installing Windrose Dedicated Server (App ID: ${SRCDS_APPID})..."
./steamcmd.sh \
    +force_install_dir /mnt/server \
    +login anonymous \
    +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows \
    +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} \
    $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) \
    $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) \
    validate \
    +quit

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Create default R5/ServerDescription.json if it does not exist
mkdir -p /mnt/server/R5
FILE=/mnt/server/R5/ServerDescription.json
if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
    echo "R5/ServerDescription.json already exists, skipping creation."
else
    echo "Creating default R5/ServerDescription.json..."
    printf '%s\n' '{' \
        '    "Version": 1,' \
        '    "DeploymentId": "",' \
        '    "ServerDescription_Persistent": {' \
        '        "PersistentServerId": "",' \
        '        "InviteCode": "server1",' \
        '        "IsPasswordProtected": false,' \
        '        "Password": "",' \
        '        "ServerName": "Windrose Server",' \
        '        "WorldIslandId": "",' \
        '        "MaxPlayerCount": 4,' \
        '        "P2pProxyAddress": "127.0.0.1"' \
        '    }' \
        '}' > "$FILE"
fi

echo "Installation completed!"

variables.name: [SERVER] Game Port
variables.description: UDP port the server listens on for game connections. Must match the port allocated in the panel. Default is 7777.

variables.name: [SERVER] Invite Code
variables.description: Custom invite code players use to find and join your server. Minimum 6 characters, alphanumeric (0-9, a-z, A-Z), case-sensitive.

variables.name: [SERVER] Password Protected
variables.description: Set to true to require a password to join, false for open access.

variables.name: [SERVER] Max Players
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous players allowed. Up to 4 is recommended for best performance; 10 players is supported with adequate hardware (>=16 GB RAM).

variables.name: [SERVER] Server Name
variables.description: The display name of your server shown to players in the browser.

variables.name: [SERVER] Server Password
variables.description: Password required to join the server. Only used when Password Protected is set to true.

variables.name: [STEAM] Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam App ID for the Windrose Dedicated Server.

variables.name: [STEAM] Beta Branch ID
variables.description: Name of the beta branch to install. Leave empty for the default (stable) branch.

variables.name: [STEAM] Beta Branch Password
variables.description: Password for the beta branch, if required.

variables.name: [WINE] Wine Debug Level
variables.description: Wine debug output verbosity. Set to -all to suppress noise.

variables.name: [WINE] Winetricks Packages
variables.description: Winetricks packages to install on first startup. Required for the server to run.

variables.name: [WORLD] World Name
variables.description: Display name for the server world. The first world is auto-created on initial startup. To rename an existing world, edit WorldDescription.WorldName in the WorldDescription.json file.

variables.name: [WORLD] World Preset Type
variables.description: Gameplay difficulty preset for the world. Valid values: Easy, Medium, Hard. Custom world parameters (mob multipliers, combat difficulty, etc.) must be edited manually in WorldDescription.json.
